findings: H100 扩训练加入 1,132,026 个去重原始标注回波，其中 22,502 个是贴屋面的高树冠。训练同时重放 Richmond 数据，并模拟条带缺测与局部遮挡。
独立点级对照中，模拟保留 20% 邻域回波时，贴树屋面固定 90% 点召回下，高树冠保留率 22.84% → 17.13%。完整点云的全范围同期指标 22.13% → 24.41%。
114 对建筑均做四组合对照。跨航测支持 49 对局部连续屋面、3 对开放缝隙，62 对证据不足。
新模型联合方案对 15 对有连续参考的建筑实际生成了联合外壳。在 74 个开放缝隙参考点上，有 0 个落入预测屋面投影。已确认的真实开放缝隙均宽于局部点间距。这些连续组的缝边外墙长度中位数由 30.05 米变为 0.16 米。
两个正缝宽小于局部点距的实测对都采用联合拟合但保留两个外壳，历史点云对缝内连续屋面的直接支撑不足。跨航测参照覆盖有观测支持的局部，完整屋顶和闭合实体仍需独立真值。

geometry.reference_scope: Open and continuous denote local corridor observations across independently flown surveys. Unknown includes missing or discordant evidence. This does not label full building identity, complete alley width, or whole-roof topology. Frozen scoring support includes seam and interior roof points.
geometry.gap_metric: Count independent cross-survey open ground XY locations with any roof above them.

heldout_point_evaluation.scope: Identical geographically isolated NOAA 2022 source records for both models. Provider class 6 with a geometric roof-edge filter is a roof proxy. Individual returns shared by two coverage windows are deduplicated.
heldout_point_evaluation.notes: Uniform and directional dropouts are synthetic sensitivity tests. Matched-recall thresholds describe classification behavior; no per-point threshold is inserted into reconstruction.
